description_en: Updates the property of a load balancing instance, such as the name and modification protection
description_zh: 更新负载均衡实例属性，如名称、修改保护等
name: UpdateLoadBalancerAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a parameter value on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: sends a check request without modifying the property of the application load balancing instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, an `HTTP_2xx` status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改应用型负载均衡实例的属性。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回`HTTP_2xx`状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the application load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the application load balancing instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. It must start with a letter, a Chinese character, or a digit
parameters.help_zh: 应用型负载均衡实例的名称，长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

fields.help_en:
The reason for enabling modification protection.

The reason must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

This parameter is valid and takes effect only when Status is set to ConsoleProtection
fields.help_zh:
开启修改保护配置的原因。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。

仅在Status为ConsoleProtection时有效且合法
fields.name: reason

fields.help_en:
The modification protection status of the application load balancing instance. Valid values:

NonProtection: disables modification protection. If Reason is specified, the value of Reason is forcibly cleared.

ConsoleProtection: enables console modification protection. If Reason is specified, the value of Reason takes effect.

If this parameter is set to ConsoleProtection, modification protection is enabled. In this case, you cannot modify the instance configurations in the load balancing console, but you can invoke API operations to modify the instance configurations
fields.help_zh:
应用型负载均衡实例的修改保护状态。取值：

NonProtection：不开启修改保护。如有配置Reason，Reason会被强制置空。

ConsoleProtection：开启控制台修改保护。如有配置Reason，Reason可生效。

当取值为ConsoleProtection，即开启修改保护后，用户不能通过负载均衡控制台修改实例配置，但可以通过调用API修改实例配置
fields.name: status
